gen-megrim-fs-merriweather-sans: Megrim is all angular, futuristic hairline strokes, every ending cut to the same measured thickness. And Merriweather Sans follows with tall, sturdy lowercase and a clearly open e, giving those thin shapes something solid to stand next to.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-switzer: Aggressive and fast, Ethnocentric pushes its wide letters apart over short ascenders and big bowls. Switzer handles the quieter job, with wire-like sans letterforms and tidy c tips that keep every word approachable.
gen-eater-montserrat: Eater's thin strokes sit beside weightier stems, with short ascenders and wide gaps that give it a dark, aggressive edge. Montserrat's generous curves and open counters make the sharpest contrast.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-manrope: Manrope keeps a bright gap at the mouth of every curve and a minimal step from capital to lowercase. Manrope's plain sans line holds one width, which lets Bushcraft's widely spaced, expressive letters take the spotlight.
gen-dafont-disorder-fs-supreme: Raw, chaotic, and loose at the seams. Disorder scatters its big lowercase well apart, while Supreme holds a crisp, heavy-looking line of letters kept open, never curled shut.
gen-dafont-neuropolitical-satoshi: Satoshi reads with a soaring x-height and a wide e that never squeezes shut. Neuropolitical does the glowing, pulled-apart geometric display work, and Satoshi quietly handles the sustained sans-serif text underneath it.
gen-dafont-stentiga-switzer: Spread out and luxurious, Stentiga opens its tracking wide and gives crossbars the heft of stems. And Switzer, with its wire-like sans-serif letters, gives that refined display a friendly Swiss footing.
gen-mystery-quest-archivo: Mystery Quest wears open jaws on every curved stroke, a bookish, nostalgic look beneath compact ascenders. Archivo has a commanding x-height in sans-serif form, so shrinking the heading or enlarging the body would flip which one leads.
gen-mystery-quest-fs-asap: Nostalgic from the first curve, Mystery Quest keeps its ascenders compact above tall lowercase. Asap follows with open-arc forms and a body height nearly matching its capitals, a readable sans partner.
gen-mystery-quest-fs-be-vietnam-pro: Bookish and a little old-fashioned, Mystery Quest opens its jaws on every curve. And Be Vietnam Pro brings steel-rod strokes with no thick-thin flicker, so a modest heading size lets the sans sit comfortably beneath it.
